output_schema.title: StableMutationResult

tools.description: Create, update, remove, move, clear, or set scales on one track. For operation=add, track_id is the new id and title, kind, and width_mm are required; add appends the track, then use operation=move for placement. Track x_scale is the shared horizontal axis/grid scale for normal and array tracks; curve binding scale is independent content scale. Array raster presentation belongs on edit_raster_binding fields such as profile, colorbar, sample_axis, and color_limits. Use operation=set_scales only when both are intentionally synchronized, or use update with x_scale and edit_curve_binding with scale independently. For update, remove, move, and clear_bindings, track_id must already exist.
tools.name: edit_track

output_schema.description: Structured result for one persisted authoring mutation.
output_schema.title: StableMutationResult
